name: moral-skit
label: Moral-lesson skit (Dhar Mann-style)
description: Scripted archetype drama: injustice hook → escalating wrongs → reveal → consequence → moral stated to camera. Make 4-5 hook/ending variants.

sync.broll: establishing exteriors and prop inserts (letters, phones) on plot-critical lines; ~90:10
sync.fillers: reaction close-up after every key line, slow push-in on realisation, flashback cut
sync.music: score per act: sad/tense during wrongs → silence or sting at the reveal → uplifting swell at the consequence/moral
sync.emotion_map: indignation → rising anger → surprise (sting + silence) → catharsis (swell) → moral warmth
sync.transitions: hard cuts, dip-to-black / time-jump cards between acts

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: general education only, no individual advice
fictional actors, 'dramatisation' tag, never posed as a patient
